title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.7.4
description:
• Meta Business Suite 200% Input Target Verification: Completely eliminated accidental typing into search bars/other fields with strict dialog container scoping and input value read-back validation.
• Guaranteed Page Verification: Zero fake successes — every created Page is independently verified across Meta Business Settings, Personal Pages portal, and live RelayModern API endpoints.
• Seamless Resilience: Automatic smart fallback to Mobile Page Creator when Meta Business Suite access is restricted for an account.
• Version Synchronization: Consistent v1.7.4 display across all headers, status badges, Settings, Page Studio, and Window Titles.
